entries.zh: 忧思忡忡；心事、忧虑不安
entries.en: anxious brooding, care; thought (word-head damaged; line continues the previous page's headword, likely pensamiento)
entries.notes: 西语词头首段残损且系页首续前页词头（疑为 pensamiento）；H 栏两读「忡忡/惦惦」借 M 栏叠字音读定为「忡忡」，释义存疑。

entries.en: promptly, in good time; to spare time
entries.notes: 西语尾字损作 tiemps（当为 tiempos），与「省时节」的义合属推断，故降中。

entries.zh: 捷决；办事务求迅速果断
entries.en: quick in dispatching business; prompt and decisive

entries.notes: 右侧溢写续文残缺不足为据，主栏「¿ vano」读法存疑，义项以 presumir 与 H 栏「擅」互证。

entries.zh: 摆架子、自夸身价；炫耀身份门第
entries.en: to boast of one's grandeur; put on airs

entries.zh: 笔头毒；自恃聪明、逞才使气
entries.en: to presume oneself wise; fancy oneself clever
entries.notes: 「笔头毒」为闽地俗语，字面义与西语「自恃聪明」之贴合属推断。

entries.zh: 擅便；擅自便宜行事、径自处置
entries.en: to act on one's own authority, presuming to govern well; take charge unbidden

entries.zh: 擅自；自作主张、径行专断
entries.en: to act presumptuously, on one's own authority; take it upon oneself

entries.zh: 目里无人；目中无人、目空一切
entries.en: presumptuous, haughty; regards nobody as his equal

entries.zh: 目中无人；眼里没有人、目空一切
entries.notes: 上一行被墨线划掉且字残，本条西语仅存词头 presumptioso，条目归属存推断。

entries.zh: 自重；自视甚高、自命不凡
entries.en: vain and presumptuous (va No read as vano); self-important
entries.notes: 「va No」推断为 vano（自恃虚荣），左侧花括弧示与下条连类。

entries.zh: 自专；独断专行、自作主张
entries.en: presumptuous, self-willed; insists on his own way
entries.notes: 西语释文尾部残损（se a~aparece），义项据词头 presumptioso 与 H 栏「自专」互证。

entries.zh: 自负；自恃、自以为了不起
entries.en: conceited, presumptuous; thinks highly of himself

entries.zh: 志；志向、抱负，有志于功名尊荣
entries.en: to aspire to greatness; ambition, aspiration

entries.zh: 志位〔第二字污损存疑〕；志在官阶尊荣
entries.en: to aspire to dignity or high office (second Chinese character smeared, uncertain)
entries.notes: H 第二字污损（T99，「饌/餒」两形均难安），据西语「谋尊位」暂拟「志位」，释义存疑待核。

entries.zh: 志气；惺惺志气〔小字存疑〕，精明而志向远大
entries.en: to aspire to grandeur; astute ambition, high aspirations
entries.notes: 行中夹小字难辨（疑乙/惺），M 栏叠音提示原行近「惺惺志气」，定义以「志气」为准。

entries.zh: 轩昂；气宇轩昂、仪态不凡
entries.en: imposing and dignified in bearing; to hold oneself grandly

entries.zh: 男儿志；男儿大志、志在四方
entries.en: to aspire to greatness as if born to reign; a man's ambition
entries.notes: 「como Reynor &」当为 reynar 之损读兼页末截断，语义展开依赖推断。
